messages:
kelly.partnerships: Kickoff: starting Orbit Labs marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need publisher tenant IDs, signed COI, EULA acceptance. Target: verify publisher accounts + submit store assets by EOD Wednesday.
maria.legal: Confirmed EULA v3 default. COI minimum $1M per occurrence. Telemetry addendum ok if we have explicit opt-in and a 1-line privacy blurb. DPA required if they want custom data handling.
ron.ops: Ops checklist: AWS cross-account role + trust.json exchange; GCP service account template ready; Azure needs tenant id, offerId, and hero image (1024x620). Will reserve placeholder SKUs in staging.
ty.product: Product packaging: trial 14d + monthly seat + metered compute bundle. Need SKU codes and short storefront descriptions (<=140 chars). Suggest SKUs: ORB-TRIAL-14, ORB-MONTHLY-1, ORB-COMPUTE.
jenna.eng: Telemetry notes: opt-in only. Add a consent checkbox in onboarding; only emit anonymized metrics after consent. Telemetry endpoint: POST /v1/marketplace/usage with header X-Marketplace-Publisher: <publisher_id>. No request bodies stored.
marketplace-bot: Verification status: AWS linked and verified. GCP and Azure pending. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/marketplace/publishers/Orbit
kelly.partnerships: Ron, please confirm SKU reservations and paste reservation IDs. Maria, I'll request COI and tenant info from Orbit and paste back here.
ron.ops: Reserved placeholders in staging: ORB-TRIAL-14 (resv-9871), ORB-MONTHLY-1 (resv-9872), ORB-COMPUTE (resv-9873). AWS role snippet for partner to run: aws iam create-role --role-name Redwood_MP_Orbit --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
ty.product: Timeline proposal: draft listing + legal artifacts today, ops finish creds tomorrow, partner verification within 48h after we receive tenant/assets. Any objections?
marketplace-bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 48h for missing GCP/Azure items.
